description: This file contains internal testing utilities for PyTorch's MKL-DNN backend, including functions to check support for bf16 and tf32, context managers to toggle precision modes, and a decorator to run tests under different precision settings.

methods.name: bf32_is_not_fp32
methods.description: Checks if BF16 is supported in MKL-DNN backend.

methods.name: tf32_is_not_fp32
methods.description: Checks if TF32 is supported in MKL-DNN backend.

methods.name: reduced_f32_on_and_off
methods.description: Decorator that runs a test three times with different reduced precision modes (off, bf16, tf32).
